openwrt_wiki.einleitung: The Linksys E8450 is a dual-band 4x4 IEEE 802.11n/ax router based on MediaTek MT7622BV for 2.4 GHz and MediaTek MT7915E (Filogic 615) for 5 GHz. It has five Gigabit Ethernet ports, one USB 2.0 port, 128 MiB SPI-NAND Flash (2k+64) and 512 MB DDR3 RAM.
openwrt_wiki.installation: Converting to UBI layout is required (since 2021-08-27 non-UBI firmware cannot be installed: vendor flash layout contains ECC errors out of the factory); install via https://github.com/dangowrt/owrt-ubi-installer; upgrade 23.05.x -> 24.10.x needs installer again (new UBI layout after 2024-02)
openwrt_wiki.flash_layout: raw SPI NAND flash memory chip (2k+64) 128 MiB
openwrt_wiki.cpu_governor: By default the CPU will constantly run at the maximum frequency of 1.35 Ghz
openwrt_wiki.reboot_hinweis: Some users may encounter an issue with the unit powering off instead rebooting
openwrt_wiki.okd: OpenWrt Kiss of Death: after power down no LEDs, no boot; caused by buggy BL2 preloader v2.9 / v2.10.0 -1/-2 (mt7622-snand-1ddr); recovery via serial with mtk_uartboot
openwrt_wiki.gehaeuse_oeffnen: peel back two stickers on bottom panel; 4 crosshead screws bottom plate; 2 screws router body to mainboard slide tray; slide tray out through the back; 3 screws on outer perimeter of mainboard; turn mainboard over for white serial connector and JTAG connector
openwrt_wiki.seriell: white COM port at J10 (the white JST PH connector); USB to TTL adapter supporting 3.3v; TX router -> RX adapter, RX router -> TX adapter; Bild media:linksys-e8450-belkin-rt3200-serial-jtag-ports.png
openwrt_wiki.jtag: unpopulated 1.27mm pitch ARM JTAG pads near the bottom of the device, ARM Standard JTAG 20-pin connector; OpenOCD scripts mtk-openwrt/openocd-scripts mt7622
openwrt_wiki.reset: While the router is powered ON, press and hold the reset button for 15 seconds. The "Router" light will begin to blink. Once the "Router" light stays solid, the reset process is complete.

lauf.notiz: ToH-Dump (E8450 + Belkin RT3200) und Live-hwdata, OpenWrt-Wiki (Rev. 2026-04-05), OpenWrt-Commits aa94e34c/02351861, DTS und mt7622.mk, Gluon-Target und Commit (ab v2022.1), WikiDevi (Rev. 2022-08-03), DeviWiki (keine Seite), FCC K7S-03571 (Grant, Handbuch mit Spezifikation, Typenschild, Außen- und Innenfotos), Linksys-Produktseite (Archiv 2023), Geizhals RT3200 (Archiv 2021), Forum-Thread 94302 (erste 20 Beiträge) ausgewertet.
